blocks: No. The closest measure in KLEAR for {geo:house:024} is {label:f1}, which is about {fact:f1}. It is a modeled estimate of the share of adults who reported housing insecurity in the past year, not a count of homeless residents. Source: {vintage:f1}.

Housing insecurity covers adults who struggled with rent, mortgage or utility payments or who had to move, and it can include people who are housed. It does not count people who are unsheltered, in shelters or living in temporary arrangements, so it cannot stand in for a homeless count. KLEAR does not hold homelessness counts; those are published by other agencies.
caveats: This is a modeled estimate with a wide uncertainty band, not a formal confidence interval, so read it as approximate. {fact:f1} {vintage:f1}
